fee_notes: Traditional Store fee is $30,000; Non-Traditional Store and Co-Branded with a Third-Party Concept fee is $15,000. Military veterans (with non-dishonorable discharge or active duty, min. 51% ownership if entity) and qualified first responders (min. 1 year service, min. 51% ownership if entity) receive 50% discount on the first Store's initial franchise fee. Under a Store Development Agreement (multi-unit), the first Store is full price and each additional Store is reduced by 50% ($15,000 for Traditional, $7,500 for Non-Traditional or Co-Branded). Fee is fully earned and nonrefundable upon payment.
raw_excerpt:
Traditional Store – the initial franchise fee is $30,000 unless you qualify for either the military veteran or first responder's discount program, to the extent applicable.
Non-Traditional Store – the initial franchise fee is $15,000 unless you qualify for either the military veteran or first responder's program discount.
RED MANGO Store Co-Branded with a Third-Party Concept – the initial franchise fee is $15,000, unless you qualify for either the military veteran or first responder's program discount, to the extent applicable.
The initial franchise fee is fully earned and nonrefundable upon payment.
